page.layout: One column of errata entries, one printed line per entry, with continuation lines indented. The final "lin.13." sits alone at the lower right of the column. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Pag.163. lin.14. id, est in caelo, pro id est, in caelo.
lin.15. & 16. Magnificavi eum Schembhamphorasch; pro Magnificavit eum per Schembhamphorasch.
Pag.168. lin.11. בְּהָנָה ׳ הַהְנָה & בְּהָנָה pro הַהְנָה ׳ בְּהָנָה [?]
lin.22. נְהִיר pro נְהִיר [?]. Sic lin. 24. נְהִיתָה pro נְהִיתָה [?]
Pag.171. lin.13. exprima pro ex prima.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants are copied as far as the scan shows them. Entries marked [?] are doubtful. The Hebrew of pages 168, 170 and 174–175 is small and blurred, and the pointing may be incomplete. The final "lin.13." stands alone at the lower right, apart from the other entries, and may be a stray line or a mark. Printed errors (Talmndico, Chiskai, Mntavit, Confsr.) are left as printed.
